candidates.explanation: When no user matches by social id but one matches by email, the code overwrites provider and socialId on the existing account for any non-inactive status. The check is inverted: it only skips inactive users, so an active password account (provider=email, confirmed) is converted to google. Email login then fails with needLoginViaProvider:google. Social login must not take over an active email/password account. It should only link or adopt accounts that are not active, or reject or keep the provider for active email accounts.

fix.description: In the `else if (userByEmail)` branch, do not overwrite provider/socialId on an active account whose provider is email. Either reject with an error (for example email: 'emailAlreadyExistsWithProvider') or log the user in without modifying provider/socialId. Only update the provider when the account is not active, or when it has no password and its provider already matches. Invert the status check accordingly.
